components.name: Search field
components.description: The shared Product search entry for exact barcode, Product-name, and brand lookup.
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: block; position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.57 0.03 145); border-radius: 16px; background: oklch(0.992 0.002 160); color: oklch(0.235 0.018 165); } .ds-search > svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; margin-left: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 16px/1.65 "Noto Sans Khmer", "Khmer OS System", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-right: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.43 0.018 165); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search button svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: oklch(0.36 0.09 157); outline: 2px solid oklch(0.36 0.09 157 / 0.35); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-search button:hover, .ds-search button:focus-visible { background: oklch(0.94 0.025 157); color: oklch(0.31 0.08 157); }

components.name: Home search entry
components.description: A familiar field-shaped link keeps Home camera-first while exposing Search accessibly.
components.html: Search by barcode or Product
components.css: .ds-home-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.57 0.03 145); border-radius: 16px; background: oklch(0.992 0.002 160); color: oklch(0.43 0.018 165); text-decoration: none; font: 16px/1.65 "Noto Sans Khmer", "Khmer OS System", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-home-search svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-home-search:hover, .ds-home-search:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.47 0.115 157); color: oklch(0.235 0.018 165); } .ds-home-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.36 0.09 157); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search result row
components.description: A full-width, source-led row for opening a Package Match candidate without a score or verdict.
components.css: .ds-result { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 76px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 112px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; background: oklch(0.992 0.002 160); color: oklch(0.235 0.018 165); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; } .ds-result + .ds-result { border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.84 0.012 160); } .ds-result-image { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 76px; height: 96px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.965 0.008 160); color: oklch(0.43 0.018 165); } .ds-result-image svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-result small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: oklch(0.43 0.018 165); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-result:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.025 157 / 0.45); } .ds-result:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.36 0.09 157); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Recent search chip
components.description: A session-only prior term, shown before typing without implying popularity.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"></circle></svg>Coconut</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.965 0.008 160); color: oklch(0.235 0.018 165); font: 400 16px/1.65 "Noto Sans Khmer", "Khmer OS System", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { background: oklch(0.94 0.025 157); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.36 0.09 157); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bottom navigation
components.description: Four-item mobile navigation that remains visible on Home and Search and uses label plus icon state.
components.html: HomeLearnHistoryAllergies
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); min-height: 80px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.84 0.012 160); background: oklch(0.992 0.002 160); } .ds-nav-item { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 32px auto; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 74px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; color: oklch(0.235 0.018 165); text-decoration: none; font: 600 12px/1.35 "Noto Sans Khmer", "Khmer OS System", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.025 157); } .ds-nav-active { color: oklch(0.36 0.09 157); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-active svg { fill: currentColor; stroke: currentColor; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.36 0.09 157); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Camera viewfinder
components.description: A pale, bounded camera surface that keeps scanner capability and failure states explicit.
components.css: .ds-camera { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 300px; overflow: hidden; background: oklch(0.965 0.008 160); } .ds-corner { position: absolute; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-color: oklch(0.36 0.09 157 / 0.9); border-style: solid; } .ds-corner-tl { top: 16px; left: 16px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; border-radius: 8px 0 0; } .ds-corner-tr { top: 16px; right: 16px; border-width: 1px 1px 0 0; border-radius: 0 8px 0 0; } .ds-corner-bl { bottom: 16px; left: 16px; border-width: 0 0 1px 1px; border-radius: 0 0 0 8px; } .ds-corner-br { right: 16px; bottom: 16px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; border-radius: 0 0 8px; } .ds-frame { width: min(288px, 80vw); height: 96px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.992 0.002 160 / 0.9); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 999px oklch(0.12 0.02 160 / 0.18); } .ds-camera-control { position: absolute; right: 32px; bottom: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.992 0.002 160 / 0.7); border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.992 0.002 160 / 0.95); color: oklch(0.36 0.09 157); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0.12 0.02 160 / 0.12); } .ds-camera-control svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-camera-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.36 0.09 157); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
LifeGoods is a calm, camera-first shopping utility. It uses the familiar structure of a barcode scanner while being unusually honest about capability and evidence: an unavailable camera looks unavailable, community data looks unreviewed, and missing fields look unknown rather than reassuring.

The visual world is white, charcoal, pale botanical neutrals, and restrained coconut green. Crisp one-pixel rules and open space create structure without decorative card stacks. The experience is Khmer-first, with generous Khmer line height and original package languages kept visible.
keyCharacteristics: Khmer-first with generous line height and original package languages kept visible.
Flat by default: tonal layers, one-pixel rules, and spacing carry depth.
Green is a restrained identity accent, never a Product verdict.
Search rows expose source evidence without scores or reassurance.
dos: Preserve field-level provenance and original-language evidence.
Keep uncertainty adjacent to the affected evidence and pair failures with recovery.
Use familiar scanning and navigation patterns with precise capability copy.
Verify representative Khmer viewports and both mobile and desktop layouts.
donts: Do not use wellness marketing, purity language, universal health scores, or “Excellent/Bad” labels.
Do not collapse absent, stale, external, or unreviewed evidence into a negative finding or reassuring absence.
Do not mix allergen evidence, Halal Ingredient Assessment, Seal Observation, and certificate status.
Do not add decorative page choreography, bounce, elastic easing, nested card grids, or oversized rounded surfaces.
Do not treat `TreePalmIcon` as final coconut artwork.
